name: B10-0120/2025 (S&D) – Continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, a Nigerian singer sentenced to death for blasphemy. It says his trial was unfair, his health is failing in detention, and he should get food, clothing and medicine. It asks Nigeria's Supreme Court to hear his appeal quickly and asks the Governor of Kano not to sign any execution order. It also restates the Parliament's opposition to the death penalty everywhere.

- The Parliament asks Nigeria to free Sharif-Aminu and drop the blasphemy charges; nothing changes automatically.
- It affects Sharif-Aminu, held in Kano State, and Nigeria's courts and governor.
- Next: European officials are asked to raise his case with Nigerian authorities.
